about_blocks.text: The Mark Amy Treatment Center is a residential rehab center. It has a 28-day program that takes on a more holistic approach to the problem of alcohol and drug addiction. The education of the patients is very important and so they receive information concerning the addiction itself and the various problems that can lead to alcohol or drug addiction. Of course, when a patient comes in the center, the first thing they do is they will interview him and so assess the gravity of his addiction so that a treatment can be planned. And during the treatment, the addict will receive counselling in the group. And they will also be able to receive one on one consultation with a professional.
